ResearchProjectDef.label: fabrication
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build fabrication benches, capable of high-tech projects ranging from component assembly to power armor construction.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
You now have the technology to build a fabrication bench - but it also requires some advanced components to get started. You can collect advanced components several ways:

 -All outlander settlements sell advanced components. Send a caravan to buy some.
 -Some visiting traders sell advanced components. Invite or wait for them.
 -Some quests are rewarded with advanced components.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->spent many years crafting advanced components, to make fabrication benches to make more advanced components
subject_story->traded everything to build a single fabrication bench
subject_story->constructed technological marvels which the feral villagers worshipped as magical
subject_story->worked on AI routines, to enable gun turrets to identify friends and foes
subject_story->designed a modular gun turret holster, capable of taking any weapon type
subject_story->disabled the enemy's turrets remotely, before leading the charge

ThingDef.label: component
ThingDef.description: Miscellaneous gears, capacitors, circuit boards, tubes, wheels, sensors, wires, chips, processors, and other electronic and industrial parts. Necessary for assembling complex machines or electronics.

ThingDef.label: advanced component
ThingDef.description: Advanced computing and energy-directing machinery, miniaturized and hardened for the most demanding applications.

ThingDef.label: hi-tech research bench
ThingDef.description: A high-tech bench with computers and electronic measurement equipment. Allows more rapid research, and unlocks advanced research projects.

ThingDef.label: plasteel
ThingDef.description: Advanced spacer tech structural material. Plasteel is extremely strong due to its unique molecular structure.

ThingDef.label: reinforced barrel
ThingDef.description: A large barrel for projectile-based weapons like mortars. In order to hold the high launch pressures, it is specially reinforced and cannot be manufactured at a small scale.

ThingDef.label: steel
ThingDef.description: An iron-carbon metal alloy used for building a huge variety of structures, weapons, and machines.
